data.title: 墨染希 · 神乐殿阶梯的月下卸装
data.description: 祭典曲终人散的神社神乐殿前，银色月光洗练石阶。希褪去了宽厚繁复的千早外袍，仅着轻薄素白的襦绊。她坐在红漆木柱边，将发烫的脸颊贴在青梅竹马的手背上，自幼相伴的深情在此刻化作无声的依偎。
data.action: sitting on steps, pressing cheek against hand, moonlight on bare neck
data.lighting: pure silver moonlight against red wooden pillars
data.promptProse: Resting on the wooden steps of the deserted shrine pavilion after the festival, Sumizome Nozomi appears in her simple white under-kimono. Silver moonlight touches her exposed neck and honey-brown hair as she gently presses her cheek against the viewer's palm.
data.animaCaption: Nozomi resting her cheek against a hand on the moonlit shrine steps.
